description: Exposed roofs and terraces – UV, ponding, thermal movement.
Landscaped podiums, decks over occupied space.
Below-grade walls and slabs against soil and groundwater.
Raft and footing protection before concreting.
Earth-retaining walls with soil and water contact.
Pool shells and balancing tanks under immersion.
Facades exposed to driving rain and sun.
Movement joints, construction joints, live cracks.
